_comment: Claude Desktop 3P - maximum lockdown, Amazon Bedrock, Linux.
IMPORTANT: this does NOT achieve zero Anthropic egress on Linux. There is no
Linux offline installer, so the app still fetches its VM workspace bundle and
Claude CLI from downloads.claude.ai when a Cowork session starts. That host
must be allowlisted or Cowork and Code sessions will not start.
Zero-egress is achievable on Windows only. See docs/06-LINUX-INSTALL.md.
Native JSON types here - real booleans and arrays.
_privatelink: Allowlist this host instead of the public runtime host.
_egress_note: disableEssentialTelemetry is deliberately omitted. Setting it opts you into a manual support model with zero remote visibility for Anthropic, and the firewall already blocks those hosts.
_otlp: Audit trail to your own collector. Use http/protobuf on :4318 - with grpc, Cowork falls back to http/protobuf and the desktop stream is always http/json, so a gRPC receiver on :4317 silently drops two of three streams.
